Conversations.summary: Who's talking: either two people, or everyone in a session. Two people only ever have one between them, whichever of them wrote first.
Conversations.make: Made by the first `POST /messages` between two people, or the first time a session's chat is opened or written in.

SessionId: A session's chat only. annotation-store's collection id, not a foreign key, since that's a different database. Who's in it is asked of annotation-store each time, not kept here
UserA: Direct only. The two people's Keycloak ids, in a fixed order so the unique index means one conversation between them

ConversationReads.summary: One person's place in a conversation: how far they've read, and whether they've deleted it. There's only a row once they've done one of those.

UserId: Their Keycloak id. The other half of the key
Hidden: They've deleted it for themselves. A new message clears this, and once both have it set the conversation goes
LastRead: Anything from someone else after this counts as unread

Messages.summary: One message. Who sent it comes from their token, along with their name when they sent it, so a list doesn't have to ask Keycloak.
Messages.make: `POST /messages` with an `id` the viewer made, `toUserId` or `sessionId`, and `body`.

Id: Made by the viewer, so sending again after a dropped connection is the same message
ConversationId: Found or made from who it's to
Body: Up to 4,000 characters. Can be empty if there's an attachment
FromUserId: Their Keycloak id, from their token

Attachments.summary: What was sent with a message, as it was when it was sent. It's a copy, so it stays the same if the original changes or goes, and whoever gets it doesn't need access to the original. messaging doesn't read the rows - the viewer sends them, and annotation-store checks them when they're added.
Attachments.make: Sent inside the message, as `attachment`. Up to 5MB.

Name: client
What to call it on the card. Up to 200 characters
InviteCode: Invites only. Opened with annotation-store's invite preview, as a link would be
Payload: Everything but invites: the rows, or for an area where it is, as a JSON object. Only sent by `GET /messages/{id}/attachment`, since it can be megabytes
SlideId: Which slide it's from. Not a foreign key
SourceCollectionId: Which collection it was copied from, for where it came from. Not a foreign key

AttachmentAdds.summary: Someone adding what was sent to a collection of theirs. Per person, since everyone in a session's chat can add the same thing, and each should see when they did.

UserId: Their Keycloak id. The other half of the key
LastAdded: Moves on if they add it again
